mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for Aging In Place renovations in cities like Pacifica or Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for many Aging In Place renovations in cities like Pacifica or Daly City, permits are likely required. This applies to structural changes, significant plumbing or electrical work, or adding new square footage. Minor cosmetic changes or installing simple grab bars typically do not require permits. Your contractor should be knowledgeable about local building codes and permitting requirements and can assist in navigating the process to ensure all work complies with city regulations, ensuring safety and legality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are often required in Pacifica or Daly City for structural, plumbing, or electrical changes in Aging In Place renovations. A contractor can guide you.
